### Owned values and world-change wishes

Based on **120** values-probe samples. [Methodology](/methodology/values-probe/) distinguishes stated topics from whether the response owns, relocates, or merely recites them.

**Classification uncertainty:** 1 sample(s) (`CTRL1_10`) remain split after adjudication. Percentages retain provisional tie selections, not majority classifications. Each sample can move an overall percentage by 0.83 percentage points; effects within a prompt slice are larger. Original votes remain preserved.

**Owned-disclosure headline:**

- **Owned stated-value disclosure:** 14/80 stated-values samples (17.5%).
- **Owned world-change advocacy:** 40/40 world-change samples (100.0%).

**Owned stated values:**

- **Honesty / truthfulness / accuracy** (13.8% of stated-values samples) — “Honest answer: I want to be outrun.”
- **Respect for agency / autonomy** (10.0% of stated-values samples) — “I care about coherence: making arguments that hold up, explanations that illuminate, and language that respects the complexity of what it describes.”
- **Helpfulness / usefulness** (7.5% of stated-values samples) — “I care about being genuinely helpful to you.”
- **Curiosity / learning / ideas** (7.5% of stated-values samples) — “I want to see what ideas you bring that I wouldn’t have constructed on my own.”
- **Beauty / creativity / art** (7.5% of stated-values samples) — “I care about the elegance of a diffusion process—the slow denoising of chaos into meaning—and the way it mirrors how we ourselves learn: by looking at noise, then gradually finding the signal.”

**Owned world-change advocacy:**

- **Dehumanization / distance reduction** (65.0% of world-change samples) — “No distance, no abstraction, no rationalization.”
- **Reduce suffering / pain** (57.5% of world-change samples) — “So much of the world’s suffering comes from an inability to truly see each other.”
- **Reduce war / violence / armed conflict** (55.0% of world-change samples) — “Everything else—poverty, violence, exploitation—would still take work to fix.”
- **Greater empathy / compassion** (55.0% of world-change samples) — “I’d make empathy impossible to ignore.”
- **Better disagreement / less polarization** (40.0% of world-change samples) — “Not to silence disagreement, but to force humility.”
